source.method: Word-by-word review by Claude (November 2026); no automatic links

1:2.note: Doublet: vessels of the house of the Lord repeated (plus); 'his god' rendered 'his idol'.

1:4.note: Plus 'to serve him'; 'able in strength' paraphrases koach bahem.

1:5.note: Word-for-word; 'then' for 'at the end of them'.

1:8.note: 'Not defile himself' rendered 'not eat'/'not feed him'; plus 'and not drink'.

1:10.note: 'Make me guilty my head' rendered 'cut off my head'.

1:12.note: Minus na; object pronoun for et.

1:16.note: Periphrastic tense; plus 'to eat and water to drink' (from v.12).

1:18.note: Minus 'to bring them' (one verb); plus 'were completed', 'king'.

2:3.note: 'I dreamed a dream' rendered 'I saw a dream'; lamed-object for et.

2:4.note: Plus 'and said'; 'to the king' rendered 'before the king'; Ketiv/Qere 'servants'.

2:5.note: Azda read as 'true'; 'from me' rendered 'that I said'; houses 'plundered' instead of made dunghill.

2:10.note: 'Because' (kol qovel di) rendered 'even never'; Ketiv/Qere Kasdaye.

2:14.note: 'Returned counsel and prudence' rendered 'considered, took counsel and said'.

2:15.note: Minus 'answered and said to Arioch the king's officer'; 'made known' rendered 'revealed'.

2:24.note: 'Therefore' rendered 'in that hour'; 'appointed to destroy' rendered 'commanded to kill'; plus 'but'.

2:27.note: Repeated 'and not'; gazrin rendered 'magians'; order of classes shifted.

2:29.note: 'Your bed' rendered 'your heart'; 'after this' rendered 'in the end'.

2:30.note: Plus 'greater'; paraphrase of 'thoughts of your heart'.

2:31.note: Minus 'that image was great'; plus 'exceedingly good'.

2:35.note: Minus 'then'; plus 'strong' (wind) and 'from it'; metals reordered.

2:37.note: 'God of heaven' rendered 'God Most High'; two power terms merged.

2:38.note: Plus 'place ... in it'; birds and beasts reordered; Ketiv/Qere dayrin.

2:40.note: Ketiv/Qere fourth; 'because' rendered 'and as'; free rendering of crushing clause.

2:43.note: Ketiv/Qere vedi; plus 'thus'; 'this with this' rendered 'one to one'.

2:45.note: 'After this' rendered 'in the latter days'; metals reordered (bronze before clay).

2:48.note: Plus 'over all the army chiefs' and 'appointed him'; medinah rendered 'land'.

3:2.note: Titles rendered by Syriac equivalents; 'dedication' rendered 'feast of the new image'.

3:7.note: Minus 'therefore'; instrument list as in v.5 (plus bagpipe, minus psanterin).

3:10.note: Plus 'which you set up'; psanterin not rendered; Ketiv/Qere forms.

3:12.note: Plus 'here'; 'paid no heed to you' rendered 'regarded you not'; Ketiv/Qere.

3:15.note: Psanterin not rendered; 'who is the god' rendered 'who is your god'.

3:18.note: Minus 'and if not' and 'to you'; Ketiv/Qere.

3:23.note: Plus 'while'. Greek addition (Prayer of Azariah / Song of the Three), no MT equivalent.

3:27.note: Plus 'all the peoples'; 'not changed' rendered 'not burned'.

3:29.note: Houses 'plundered' instead of dunghill; Ketiv/Qere shalu.

4:4.note: Minus 'then'; plus 'before me'; gazraya rendered 'magians'; Ketiv/Qere.

4:6.note: Plus 'vision of my head' (doublet), 'you', 'to me'; ith + bak renders bakh; 'troubles you' rendered 'is hidden from you'.

4:14.note: Minus 'until the matter'; plus 'he'; Ketiv/Qere forms.

4:18.note: Plus 'flesh', 'all' and clause 'from it all flesh was fed' (from v.9); ith beh = beh.

4:20.note: Plus 'called with might' and clause on grass/heart from vv.12-13.

4:22.note: Plus clause 'sets up the lowest of men' (from v.14); enclitic hu belongs to shallit.

4:24.note: Minus 'king'; 'lengthening of your ease' read as 'until your follies depart'.

4:27.note: Minus 'king'; 'might of my power' rendered 'my strong dominion'.

4:29.note: Plus 'shall be', dew clause, 'God', and 'sets up the lowest of men' (harmonized with vv.22, 14); enclitic hu with shallit.

4:33.note: Minus 'for the glory of my kingdom my majesty and splendour returned'; rawrbanay = haddabray (as 3:24), 'chiefs of my forces' = rabrebanay.

5:7.note: Plus 'wise men' in list; gazraya rendered 'magians'; Ketiv/Qere.

5:10.note: Minus second 'queen'; plus 'to the king'; Ketiv/Qere allat.

5:11.note: Plus 'there is', 'much'; minus final 'your father the king'.

5:12.note: 'Declaring riddles' rendered 'grasping riddles'; word order shifted.

5:21.note: Plus hair/nails clause (from 4:30) and 'gives it ... the lowest of men' (from 4:14); enclitic hu with shallit.

5:23.note: Plus 'and did not honour'; gold/silver reordered; Ketiv/Qere.

5:24.note: Word-for-word; writing clause moved to next verse. End of MT 5:24 ('this writing was inscribed') begins Syriac verse.

5:25.note: End of MT 5:24 ('this writing was inscribed') begins Syriac verse.

6:4.note: Minus 'this'; 'above chiefs and satraps' rendered 'above all of them'.

6:5.note: Plus 'after him', 'in his God'; minus second 'all'.

6:13.note: 'Concerning the king's interdict' replaced by 'O king live forever'; cognate constructions 'decreed a decree', 'ask a petition' grouped; plus vocative 'O king'.

6:25.note: Casting narrated twice (command and execution); wives before sons.

7:11.note: Minus 'I watched then because of the sound of the great words the horn spoke' (homoioteleuton of 'I was watching').

7:12.note: 'Their dominion was taken away' with plus 'from'.

7:13.note: Minus 'in the night visions, behold'; 'with clouds' rendered 'upon clouds'.

7:17.note: Plus 'and he said to me'; 'which are' rendered 'which you saw'.

8:2.note: Minus 'and it came to pass when I saw'; 'vision' rendered 'dream'.

8:4.note: Minus et; 'none to rescue' rendered 'none escaped'.

8:7.note: Minus 'I saw him'; plus 'of the he-goat'.

8:11.note: 'Magnified itself' rendered 'reached'; 'chief of the host' as 'chiefs of the hosts'; Ketiv/Qere.

8:14.note: 'To me' rendered 'to him'; 'sanctuary justified' rendered 'righteousness prevail'.

8:25.note: 'Without hand' rendered 'by the seizing of a hand'.

9:2.note: Syriac adds 'I saw'; 'to fulfil' rendered 'when completed'.

9:3.note: 'I lifted my face'; nouns rendered with 'in'.

9:5.note: Ketiv/Qere both mapped; 'turning aside' rendered finite.

9:11.note: 'upon them' for 'upon us'; 'you brought' for 'was poured'.

9:12.note: Relative d- carries asher three times; Syriac adds 'like it'; 'all' omitted.

9:13.note: 'we did not pray before' for 'entreat the face'.

9:16.note: Adds 'which you did with us' and 'your people scattered in every place'; hwat renders le- of le-herpah; 'please' omitted.

9:21.note: Syriac adds 'and flew and came from heaven'.

9:25.note: Adds 'Jerusalem'; 'distress of times' rendered 'end of times'.

10:5.note: 'garments of honour' for linen; 'honour of glory' for gold of Uphaz.

10:6.note: 'like beryl' replaced by 'was changed and had no likeness'; 'shoulders' for feet; 'many armies' for multitude.

10:7.note: Second 'the vision' omitted; 'from fear' for 'in hiding'.

10:9.note: First 'I heard his words' clause omitted; 'I fell' for 'I was in deep sleep'.

10:16.note: 'I could not stand' for 'I retained no strength'.

11:2.note: 'behold' omitted; 'in his place' for 'in his wealth'.

11:5.note: 'his dominion' omitted; 'and his princes' as subject.

11:6.note: Adds 'between them'; 'from the fear that she fears' paraphrases the zeroa clause (zeroa taken from zw'); 'her maidens' for 'who begot her'; demonstrative for article.

11:7.note: 'from the root of her seed' for 'from a shoot of her roots'.

11:10.note: Ketiv/Qere mapped; 'multitude' and infinitive omitted; adds 'upon him'.

11:12.note: 'he will destroy' for 'be carried away'; Ketiv/Qere merged.

11:14.note: 'king of the North' for 'king of the South'.

11:15.note: Clause 'there is no strength in them to stand' is a doublet (both copies linked); plus 'because', 'and they shall rise', 'and shall not be able'.

11:17.note: 'all his people' for 'upright ones'; 'he will pass over' for 'do'.

11:18.note: 'turn' doubled reduced; adds 'of the sea'; 'without' omitted.

11:22.note: 'their strength of the cities' loosely for 'arms of the flood'.

11:24.note: 'in peace' and 'he will come' omitted; 'their cities' for fortresses.

11:27.note: Adds 'these'; 'because the end has come' for 'for still the end'.

11:28.note: 'and return to his land' at end omitted.

11:29.note: First half of verse omitted; only 'as the former, so also the latter'.

11:30.note: 'camps of the Kittim'; 'act and return' omitted.

11:35.note: 'to make white' omitted; adds 'there is a limit'.

11:39.note: Ketiv/Qere merged as 'whom he will see'; 'increase honour' omitted.

11:41.note: 'land of Israel' for 'glorious land'; 'be killed' for 'stumble'.

11:42.note: 'will not escape from his hands' paraphrase.

11:43.note: 'will be at his help' for 'at his steps'.

11:45.note: 'beautiful place' for 'palace'; 'and keep his holiness' for 'holy glorious mountain'.

12:1.note: 'angel' for 'prince'; 'from the days of the world' for 'since there was a nation'; 'until that time' omitted.

12:3.note: 'doers of good and wise'; adds 'will be shining and standing'.

12:5.note: Second 'on the bank of the river' abbreviated.

12:6.note: 'garments of honour' for linen; 'this end' for 'end of the wonders'.
